Title: Handoff
Detail_lesson: A project review notes that most of the delay happened at a single **Handoff** between two teams.
CustomInstruction: Type five single words, not phrases. Include the obvious ones - overlap between people is the whole point of the exercise.

Title: Deadline
Detail_lesson: The quarterly plan is circulated with one date highlighted in bold: the **Deadline**.
CustomInstruction: Give five single words that describe how this lands for you, not what the dictionary says. First instinct, no editing.

Title: Backlog
Detail_lesson: A new joiner opens the tracker for the first time and asks what everything in the **Backlog** is for.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. Aim for what the thing actually is in your team, not what it is supposed to be.

Title: Trust
Detail_lesson: During a team health check, the highest and lowest scoring statement both turn out to be about **Trust**.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. Include behaviours as well as feelings - what trust looks like counts as much as how it feels.

Title: Accountability
Detail_lesson: A leadership update says the priority for this year is stronger **Accountability** across the organisation.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. If a word feels uncomfortable, type it anyway - the honest cluster is more useful than the polished one.

Title: Mentor
Detail_lesson: Someone two years into their career asks you how to find a **Mentor**.
CustomInstruction: Five single words describing what the role does in practice, not the qualities a mentor should have on paper.

Title: Automation
Detail_lesson: A proposal lands on your desk promising significant **Automation** of a process your team runs by hand today.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. Split them naturally between what you gain and what you give up - do not balance them deliberately.

Title: Legacy
Detail_lesson: An architecture diagram labels one large box in the middle simply as **Legacy**.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. Describe what it is like to work with, not whether it should be replaced.

Title: Feedback
Detail_lesson: A customer call ends with an offer to send through some detailed **Feedback**.
CustomInstruction: Five single words for your genuine first reaction, before the professional one arrives.

Title: Onboarding
Detail_lesson: A prospective customer signs the contract and asks how long **Onboarding** usually takes.
CustomInstruction: Five single words. Answer from the customer's side of the process rather than yours.
